description: This file defines API client functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to invoices, clients, users, and profiles, using axios for HTTP requests. It includes configuration for request interceptors to handle authorization tokens.

methods.name: fetchInvoice
methods.description: Fetches a specific invoice by ID.

methods.name: addInvoice
methods.description: Creates a new invoice with provided data.

methods.name: updateInvoice
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice identified by ID.

methods.name: fetchInvoicesByUser
methods.description: Fetches invoices based on a search query related to user.

methods.name: fetchClients
methods.description: Fetches a list of clients, paginated.

methods.name: fetchClientsByUser
methods.description: Fetches clients based on a search query related to user.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with provided credentials.

methods.name: fetchProfilesBySearch
methods.description: Fetches profiles based on search query parameters.

methods.name: fetchProfilesByUser
methods.description: Fetches profiles based on user search query.
